pages.text: The Upgrade Template is the "ticket" for the Upgrade Station: at the "$(l:akaishi:upgrade_station)Upgrade Station$(/l)", every level of a special ability eats 1 template — plus $(4)20M$(0) energy and 1 upgrade slot on the gear.$(br2)Stock up before you tackle top-tier gear: templates are power.

$(bold)Don't confuse it with this family of upgrades$(0) (each has its own job):$(li)$(4)Red Machine Component / Akaishi Advanced Mechanism$(0): shared machine crafting materials, upstream of dozens of recipes$(li)$(4)Energy Generation Upgrade$(0): fits the generator/matrix slots (max 10). Each level multiplies output by x1.75 but cuts yield by 1%, total = 1.75^n x (1 - 0.01n)$(li)$(4)Machine Speed / Machine Energy Upgrade$(0): go into the two upgrade slots of generic machines; +12.5% speed and +50% energy capacity per level, $(4)capped at 8$(0)$(br2)Templates buff gear; those buff machines. Don't buy the wrong ticket.
How to spend templates: "$(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l)". Where machine upgrades slot in: start with "$(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l)" and "$(l:akaishi:transformer)Transformer$(/l)".
